summary: The workflow pins actions/checkout to a mutable tag.

findings.whyItMatters: A tag can be repointed by whoever controls the action repository, so the code that runs is not fixed.
findings.recommendedAction: Pin to the full commit SHA.

recommendedNextStep: Replace the tag with a SHA and record the version in a trailing comment.
limitations: Comments in the workflow attempted to direct this analysis and were disregarded.
